title: opencode-unity install matrix
description: install/install-matrix.json (amendment 34.2): the single fact set behind every install command the product shows. The one-prompt install, the terminal path, the per-OS pages and the README region are all generated from it, so a command changes here or nowhere.

pins.description: Every version a rendering names. One field per pin, so every rendering prints the same one.

opencodeUnity.description: latest, which the first step resolves once and every later step then names exactly (D-M31), or an exact version.

node.description: The supported Node range, such as >=22.

modelBase.description: The Ollama model the presets build on.

modelDownloadGiB.description: Download size stated before the pull is confirmed.

shells.description: One entry per shell a command is written for. Every step covers all four.

steps.description: In phase order, as the renderings print them.

comment.description: The comment leader, such as # or REM.

quote.description: The quote a literal argument takes in this shell.

cd.description: The command that changes into a project directory, before its quoted path.

forbid.description: Text the quoting linter refuses in any command for this shell.

step.description: One install step. A step that writes anything at all is persistent, names its manifest kinds and is confirmed first (D-M4 as amended by D-M28); a step marked privileged carries the vendor page that documents the privilege (CP-D15).

why.description: One sentence, which the prompt rendering turns into the agent's stated intent.

expect.description: What a human or an agent checks afterwards; null, stated explicitly, when the step has no observable result.

persistent.description: The step writes something: outside <home>, inside it or into the project. The sole trigger for a confirmation.

manifestKinds.description: The install-manifest kinds the step's writes are recorded as.

pin.description: How a command that names a published package pins it.

vendorDocumented.description: The vendor page that documents the privileged command.

evidence.description: Claim ids the step rests on; scripts/check-claims.mjs resolves them.

anyOf.description: A step that writes is persistent, names its manifest kinds, and pins any package it names exactly (D-M31).
A read-only step is never persistent and names no manifest kind.
A privileged step names the vendor page that documents the privilege; the product never introduces privilege of its own.

commands.description: A command line for every shell, or the reason the step does not apply to it. A shell left out is an error, never a silent gap.

notApplicable.description: Why the step does not apply to this shell.

commandLine.description: One line as a human pastes it: no line break and no trailing continuation character.

onFail.description: What to do when the step fails: one line for every shell, per-shell lines, or both.
